purpose: Test whether simple causal 1-minute price-state features identify future FX directionality, volatility expansion, or mean reversion before any strategy-PnL conditioning.

data.bar_semantics: quote-derived forex aggregates, not executed-trade bars
data.universe_selection: preselected major liquid currency pairs without inspecting strategy or state-result PnL
data.gap_policy: all required one-minute timestamps must exist; no interpolation, forward fill, alternate timestamp, or synthetic spread

return_definition: r_t = ln(close_t / close_{t-1}) on exact consecutive one-minute bars

FXS_H1_TREND_EFFICIENCY_CONTINUATION.directional_efficiency: abs(sum(last 15 one-minute returns)) / sum(abs(last 15 one-minute returns))

FXS_H2_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_PERSISTENCE.baseline: sqrt(mean(r^2)) over the 60 exact returns ending immediately before the current 15-return window
FXS_H2_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_PERSISTENCE.current_vol: sqrt(mean(r^2)) over the most recent 15 exact returns
FXS_H2_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_PERSISTENCE.control: same target at all eligible 15-minute grid timestamps regardless of trigger
FXS_H2_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION_PERSISTENCE.effect: triggered target mean minus control target mean

FXS_H3_BOLLINGER_DISPLACEMENT_REVERSION.center: mean(log close) over 20 exact closes ending at t
FXS_H3_BOLLINGER_DISPLACEMENT_REVERSION.scale: sample standard deviation of log close over the same 20 closes, denominator n-1

D0_survival_gate.note: Each family must pass every applicable gate to unlock its unchanged D2 replication.
